svg.title: Zip-tie column spacing
svg.desc: This dial changes no shape. Changes no shape of its own: the zip-tie columns sit zip_edge_offset inside the pocket wall; this dial only feeds the auto-fit finger keep-out, which trimmed the row spacing by 0.05 mm at the Custom defaults.
svg.text: Changes no shape of its own: the zip-tie columns sit zip_edge_offset inside
the pocket wall; this dial only feeds the auto-fit finger keep-out, which
